entities.summary: James Buchanan's tenure as the 15th president of the United States began on March 4, 1857, and ended on March 4, 1861. Buchanan, a Democrat from Pennsylvania, took office after defeating the Republican candidate, John C. Frémont, and the Know Nothing candidate, former President Millard Fillmore, in the 1856 presidential election. He declined to seek re-election and was succeeded by Republican Abraham Lincoln.
